name: The Doer (Realistic)
description: You like working with your hands, tools, and machines. You prefer practical problems and outdoor activities.

name: The Thinker (Investigative)
description: You love analyzing, solving puzzles, and understanding how the world works. You value logic and precision.

name: The Creator (Artistic)
description: You are expressive, original, and independent. You love creating things without strict rules.

name: The Helper (Social)
description: You love helping, teaching, and healing others. You are friendly and trustworthy.

name: The Persuader (Enterprising)
description: You are a natural leader. You are energetic, ambitious, and good at convincing others.

name: The Organizer (Conventional)
description: You like structure, rules, and clear procedures. You are organized, careful, and efficient.
